title: Arrow and measurement Appearance shows only Style, Chip, Color, Marker and Size, with the rest under Advanced
goal: Appearance for an arrow becomes Arrow style tiles, Chip tiles, one Color row that tints line, head and chip together, Marker and an S M L Size, with Line, Head, Chip Fill, Edge and Text, Thickness, Head Size and Ending folded under a collapsed Advanced that reads from Color or from style until a part is set by hand.
notes: Split from caption-and-measurement-chips-come-in-a-set-of-p. Already built there: AnnotationContent.captionPartsByHand (Fill/Edge/Text set by hand, kept through style and colour changes), resetCaptionPartsByHand, EditorState.resetChipParts(ids:) (no UI yet), the chip re-deriving from the line ink on every colour change. Still needed: head following the line, the Size control, the Advanced fold and its from-labels, moving Line/Head/Label rows (PartsInspector rows) under it, and the same for measurements once every-measurement-wears-the-same-chip-styles-col lands.
acceptance: Appearance for an arrow reads top to bottom: Arrow, Chip, Color, Marker, Size, then a collapsed Advanced; a measurement has no Arrow row (markup.md section 8)
One Color pick retints the line, the head and the chip at once; the head follows the line unless it was set by hand
Size S, M and L set the chip type size (10.5, 12, 14 at the specimen scale) and padding, and may scale line weight; Thickness and Head Size set by hand override it
Under Advanced each part reads from Color or from style until set by hand, a part set by hand stays overridden, and a reset puts it back
Walk at Next defaults reaches every row with no switch changed, and a side by side with the prototype (queue/audits/2026-10-31-chip-styles-proto.html) is in the audit

log.note: From any-colour-you-pick-for-an-arrow-or-measurement (91a9d770): the Color row exists now (MarkupInkRow, between Chip and Marker; head follows the line unless painted apart). Open question for this task: a new arrow is drawn in #FF3B30, which is not in the design system's eight (#FF375F is its red), so a fresh arrow lights the Custom well; decide the arrow tool's default ink when the Appearance is simplified.

From five-more-arrow-styles (2026-11-01): the arrow's tile row is still headed 'Style' where markup.md section 8 calls it 'Arrow' (beside 'Chip'). Left for this task since it rewrites the Appearance rows; the ten tiles are now picture-only, five across, the same tile as the Chip row.

Adversarial review before building: a Photoshop/redline user expects colour first and parts tucked away; risks were hiding the caption words (kept under Advanced as Caption, with corners and a typed Label size that overrides Size), Role reading 'Size' beside the S M L Size (moved Role under Advanced for measurements), and a mixed arrow+box selection (keeps the full list).

Chose: Size derived from the chip's type size (no new stored field), arrow line 3/4/5 px, measurement caliper unchanged; Chose keeping the pre-styles measurement pill (the user's 2026-10-13 navy default) over starting measurements on Today, which changed the default fill to #1E4075; Chose adding Chip Size to the right-click menus (actions live where you click); Chose tinting Arrow tiles with the arrow's ink as the prototype does.

Verified: MarkSizeTests (12) and full Scripts/test.sh green; layout, right-click S/M/L, from-labels, painting a chip part by hand (Reset shows) on arrow and measurement, all in the probe at Next defaults (pictures looked at: vs-proto composite, 2-large, 3-small, 4-by-hand, 5-measurement). Not proven by walk: pointer clicks on Size and Advanced, Reset clicked, because panel presses under walks are dead on this Mac (reproduced on HEAD with my work stashed; logged on walks-that-fail-in-the-full-sweep-26).
left rough: a new arrow is drawn in #FF3B30, not one of the eight swatches, so Custom is lit on a fresh arrow; a default-ink change touches Current's AnnotationStyles too, so not done here.

Appearance for a picked arrow is Arrow, Chip, Color, Marker, Size (S M L) and a closed Advanced holding Line, Head, Chip Fill/Edge/Text (each from Color, from style, or Reset once set by hand), Thickness and Head Size (Overrides Size + Reset), Ending, Ends and the caption; a measurement gets the same without the Arrow row. Commit eac717d7. Verified: MarkSizeTests and full Scripts/test.sh green; in the probe at Next defaults the layout, right-click Chip Size S/M/L, from-labels and painting a part by hand on arrows and measurements; side by side with the prototype in queue/audits/2026-11-01-markup-appearance.json. Pointer clicks on Size/Advanced not walk-proven: panel presses under walks are dead on this Mac (logged on walks-that-fail-in-the-full-sweep-26).
